records.text: Like in theory, theoretically, just like as an example, Pam (Pam Bondi)? With respect to FARA and 951, the Counterintelligence and Export Control Section, including the FARA unit, shall focus on civil enforcement, regulatory initiatives, and public guidance.
records.speaker: Ian Carroll
